audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phase side read 'Skill' while the content layer and packet levelChart read Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Orianna/Skill/Orianna.
audit.why: 52.63% over 1695 games with Orianna owning levels 1-3 on range and Mel needing to walk up to stack Overwhelm; level 6 is Orianna's because Golden Eclipse's execute needs her low first and Command: Protect denies the threshold.
audit.corrected: Full sides 0/1/2 set to Orianna, row 4 set to Orianna.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.spikes both said level 6 'doubles your lane presence' — generic and it says nothing about Mel.
audit.why: The level 6 row here is about Golden Eclipse (120/100/80) being an Overwhelm-stack execute that fires at any range, and about Command: Protect (9s) keeping you above the threshold.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around the execute threshold and the 9s shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Rebuttal prevents damage outright, never gives its cooldown, and never says Golden Eclipse has no range limit.
audit.why: Rebuttal (W) is 38/35/33/29/26s — the longest cooldown in the lane — and Riot's text says it 'prevents her from taking damage', so any spell you land inside it is wasted regardless of reflection. Golden Eclipse (R) is listed at 25000 range and strikes all Overwhelm-marked enemies 'regardless of their distance from her', so walking away does not save you. Solar Snare (E, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, 1000 range) is her only hard CC and her only setup for Radiant Volley (Q, 10/9/8/7/6, 950). Searing Brilliance (P) loads up to nine bonus projectiles onto her next attack after any cast — the auto wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and the do/don't bodies now carry the 38s Rebuttal window, the 1000-range root and the global ultimate.

audit.why: 52.63% over 1695 games, already reflected as an even-to-favourable lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel is female and the entire full layer addressed her as he/his — tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave, five phase whys, two do/don't titles and report[3]/[9]/[11]. dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[2].d were also unrelated strings pasted under their titles.
audit.why: champ-gender lists mel as female; a third-person pronoun on this page refers to the enemy.
audit.corrected: All of them regendered in the same pass, and the two bled bullets rewritten to match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions feed proposes 'Mel can cut your retreat with Rebuttal (W)' on a terrain flag.
audit.why: Riot's own description of Rebuttal is a barrier around herself that reflects projectiles, prevents damage and grants movement speed — no terrain is created. The terrain flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire and I did not write it.
audit.corrected: Not written. Rebuttal is described only as a damage-prevention window.

notes: Mel is female; the full layer was written for a male enemy throughout and every occurrence is regendered above. The missing-interactions feed suggested 'Rebuttal cuts your retreat' from a terrain flag — Riot's description says the barrier forms around herself and creates no terrain, so I did not write it (flag misfire). Full-layer chart sides were all 'Skill' and disagreed with both the content layer and packet.levelChart on rows 0,1,2,4; content was already right so only full sides move. Not asserted: whether Orianna's Command: Attack specifically is reflectable by Rebuttal — the kit does not confirm it, so the page argues from 'prevents her from taking damage', which is in Riot's text. phases[N].rating left untouched: the rating scale is inconsistent across this dataset and I could not tell whether it encodes difficulty or advantage.
